gloss: to add (in writing); to write in addition

definitions.gloss: to add (in writing); to write in addition; to append
definitions.explanation: To insert or attach additional written content to an existing document, note, or text, such as appending a remark to a memo or adding a clause to a contract.

examples.japanese: メモに{一言|ひとこと}{書|か}き{加|くわ}えた。
examples.english: I added a word to the memo.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}に{新|あたら}しいデータを{書|か}き{加|くわ}えた。
examples.english: I added new data to the report.

examples.japanese: {契約書|けいやくしょ}に{条件|じょうけん}を{一|ひと}つ{書|か}き{加|くわ}えてもらえますか。
examples.english: Could you add one condition to the contract?

notes:
A compound verb formed from {書|か}く (to write) and {加|くわ}える (to add). Used when appending or inserting additional written content to an existing document or text.

USAGE:
The target document is marked by に, and the content being added is marked by を:
- 〜に〜を{書|か}き{加|くわ}える

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メモに{書|か}き{加|くわ}える: to add to a memo
- {注釈|ちゅうしゃく}を{書|か}き{加|くわ}える: to add an annotation
- {補足|ほそく}を{書|か}き{加|くわ}える: to add a supplement
- {余白|よはく}に{書|か}き{加|くわ}える: to write in the margin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add on — more general, not limited to writing
- {追記|ついき}する: to add a postscript — more formal, often at the end of a document
- {書|か}き{足|た}す: to write more, to supplement — very similar, slightly more casual
